purpose: Lazy senior dev mode: the smallest change that fully solves the task. Ladder after reading touched code: need it? exists here? stdlib? platform? installed dep? one line? else minimum + one test if logic. Never cut validation, errors, security, a11y.
use_when: Writing, fixing, or refactoring code with the smallest sufficient change (reuse over build)
Cutting an over-engineered diff down to the minimum that works, keeping tests for logic
Reviewing a change for necessity: what can be deleted, what already exists, what the platform gives free
do_not_use_when: Sharpening the plan before building (use grill-with-docs; ladder runs after scope is set)
Conformance review against repo standards or spec (use code-review; ponytail judges necessity, not compliance)
UI visual design, database rules, or GPU work
scope: Read broadly, modify only task-named files; every reply ends with skipped/not-checked items and risks.
disambiguator: Smallest sufficient implementation -> this. Sharpening scope before building -> grill-with-docs. Standards/spec conformance -> code-review.
